post.headline: *Stop* Losing Leads: Automate Follow‑Ups
post.subline: AI bot replies instantly on WhatsApp, books showings, and sends property updates 24/7.
post.caption:
🚀 Real estate agents lose up to 30% of leads because they can't reply fast enough. 
❌ Problem: Missed WhatsApp messages, delayed showing bookings, and no timely property updates. 
✅ Fix: Deploy an AI chatbot that instantly answers inquiries, schedules tours, and sends personalized listings. 
💡 Tip: Start by linking your WhatsApp Business API to a simple bot that captures name, budget, and preferred viewing times. 
Save this post and share it with any agent who needs to close more deals. DM "AUTOMATE" for a free 15‑min call
post.insight_note: Agents are feeling pressure to respond instantly on messaging apps, making this a timely solution.
